purpose: 候选界面概念，供用户审核；未修改应用代码，未发布或推送。
shared_scene: 正在冲煮的同一时刻；出液 36 g 是概念占位值，不是实测推荐参数。
review: 已修正 A 关火控件重复、C 蒸汽来源/原理文案/杯子状态。生图中的部件轮廓、水路颜色过渡及结构尚须人工核验重绘；不能直接当作科学图或真实仿真结果。
constraints: 咖啡小馆来单或自由创作后直接使用器具
结构、原理和安全提示伴随当前操作，阅读保留状态
拧壶、移壶、搅匀和倒杯由有界动画完成
控制、水位、水路和出液采用真实 HTML/SVG 或 WebGL 状态，而非整图热点假交互
意式广告海报语汇、呼吸感、精简界面

candidates.name: 剖面工坊
candidates.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: ONE high-fidelity landscape desktop web interface candidate, around 1600x1000, edge-to-edge app content, no browser or monitor frame. New design for the user's interactive Moka coffee science HTML, not a redesign of the reference image itself.
Input image 1 is a style/material reference only: warm Italian advertising poster typography and satin aluminum. Do not reproduce its three-panel layout.
Primary request: candidate A, a beautiful SECTION-FIRST WORKSHOP during active brewing. Visually distinct from an immersive cafe scene: flat editorial canvas, one large elegant scientific sectional illustration as the hero, restrained real material shading, excellent breathing space.
Art direction: sophisticated Italian commercial poster with warm ivory, rust-red, espresso ink, sparse desaturated blue water, expressive condensed diagonal 'ACQUA' typography behind the object. No aged brown wash, dirty paper, ornate decoration, generic SaaS dashboard or huge footer. At least a quarter of the screen is quiet negative space.
Layout: tiny back link upper left; a short large Chinese headline on left occupying only upper quarter, center hero cutaway Moka occupying about half the width, slender flat controls on right with no heavy enclosing card. Bottom has a tiny brew status line only, not a large row of buttons. Chinese UI typeset as clean contemporary sans serif, Italian display lettering provides poster character.
Hero: upright precisely assembled octagonal aluminum Moka with closed lid, black bakelite handle, brass valve. All parts and chimney share one straight assembly axis. Render as a front-view SVG-feasible sectional diagram, finely outlined vessel walls with very limited gradients, never a fantasy transparent full glass pot. Lower boiler contains pale blue water and a visible air space; funnel tube reaches down into liquid, powder basket at the neck, filter and seal above, central chimney reaches into upper collector. Thin understated blue upward path through funnel, changing coffee brown after the powder bed and exiting chimney into upper collector. No steam pumping the coffee bed, no separate water pump, no giant valve or unsupported exploded hot parts. Labels attach by simple thin leader lines. This is a virtual section, not an instruction to open a hot pot.
Use only this sparse Chinese text, rendered cleanly and verbatim: '返回小馆', '水，向上。', '压力变化，推动液态水穿过粉层。', '空气空间', '粉层', '出液 36 g', '火力', '微火', '小火', '关火收杯', '看看结构 ↗', '金属很烫，握手柄。'. Do not invent other paragraphs or numerical pressure/temperature gauges.
Interaction affordances: three discreet part hotspots, a simple HTML range with small-fire selected, separate rust-colored clipped-corner '关火收杯' button, and an understated contextual structure link. Pressing stop would animate removal and pouring automatically; never require twisting or physically dragging the pot. Put hot-metal notice by the vessel, not a blocking popup.
Technical feasibility: diagram can be SVG with animated liquid level/path masks; controls and text are real HTML/CSS. No room geometry, reflections, cloth simulations, freehand water pouring or camera tracking. Keep polished metal as modest optional texture, not ray-traced chrome. One coherent desktop screen, not a storyboard or comparison sheet. All labels readable, fine margins and spacing.
candidates.correction_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit, UI correction. The reference image is the edit target. Keep the entire image composition, typography, model, cutaway, colors, spacing and all existing labels exactly unchanged EXCEPT the small heat selector on the right. Replace its three-position slider and three captions with an elegant two-position selector: one hollow circle on the left labelled '微火', one filled rust circle on the right labelled '小火', linked by a thin neutral line. Keep the separate large rust '关火收杯' button and the structure link unchanged. Do not write '关火收杯' under the heat selector; that action exists only once as the separate button. No other changes. Preserve excellent breathing space and image dimensions.

implementation.approach: 经核验的 Blender 剖面静帧底图，加 SVG 水位、水路、部件热点及 HTML 火力控件。若追求纯矢量与手机清晰度，需重新绘制简化剖面。
implementation.tradeoff: 科普水路最直观，材质可稳定；不支持任意旋转，内部结构需依据实体尺寸重建。

candidates.name: 窗边吧台
candidates.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: ONE high-fidelity landscape desktop web interface candidate, around 1600x1000, edge-to-edge app content, no browser or monitor frame.
Input image 1 is the actual current app, only for interaction continuity. Input image 2 is the approved style/material reference: refined Italian advertising poster typography and warm aluminum. These are references, not edit targets. Do not reproduce the existing three-column composition.
Primary request: candidate B, an IMMERSIVE THREE-DIMENSIONAL WINDOW COUNTER while a Moka brews. The simple three-dimensional space is the principal interface; interactive HTML controls float neatly on clear margins. It should feel like an inviting small Italian coffee workshop, with modern disciplined graphic design, not an ornate antique room.
Composition: the 3D scene takes roughly 75 percent of the screen. A warm ivory stone counter, one flat cream wall and simple rectangular window, a single rust poster plane with large diagonal 'FUOCO', a satin aluminum assembled Moka on a dark enamel single burner near center-right, closed lid, matching black handle and brass valve. Only one plain porcelain cup rests off to the side. Soft warm directional window light, small contact shadows, physically plausible muted aluminum reflections. Scene geometry is sparse and reproducible in Three.js; no complicated cafe interiors, city panorama, many plants, many props, glitter or greasy sepia texture.
Substantially different layout from candidate A: a short editorial title at upper left with plenty of open space; a compact unboxed section inset at lower left, about 220x230, showing the active water path; heat and stop controls together in a small horizontal ivory strip below the central scene, under 12 percent of screen height. A small order ticket at upper right. No dashboard panels, navigation bar, giant bottom tutorial cards or full-length step sidebar.
Hero Moka has correct coherent octagonal proportions and straight assembly axis; closed lid during heating, small blue flame remains within base diameter. The 3D pot stays assembled while brewing. Section inset is a diagram: water and air in lower boiler, submerged funnel tube, powder basket at neck, filter/seal, chimney into upper collector; thin liquid path becomes coffee brown after powder layer. No visible liquid pumping through metal exterior. Add one subtle hotspot by the pot body to reveal local explanation; keep its hot-metal label distinct from draggable controls.
Use only sparse verbatim Chinese: '返回小馆', '守住这一口。', '窗边的长杯', '小火慢煮', '出液 36 g', '火力', '微火', '小火', '关火收杯', '看看里面 ↗', '金属很烫，握手柄。'. A small 'FUOCO' Italian display word on the flat wall poster is allowed. All other microcopy omitted.
Interaction must be believable: obvious HTML heat control, separate stop action; pot rotations can be limited to one constrained product-view camera, automatic bounded camera transitions for prepare/brew/serve. Stop triggers automatic removal, stirring and pour. No user twist gestures, floating AR menus, invisible hand controls or water physics.
Implementation ceiling: one GLB pot and stove, simple table/window/wall planes, one shared environment light and directional shadow, small SVG inset, ordinary HTML controls. The render should look refined but plausibly WebGL real-time, not a luxurious path-traced film set. Comfortable typography and generous whitespace. One complete screen, not a moodboard.

implementation.approach: Three.js 可拆分 GLB、简化墙窗与台面、环境光和一盏方向光；HTML 控件与 SVG 剖面浮层独立于 WebGL。窗外及非交互背景可使用静态平面。
implementation.tradeoff: 空间感和镜头表现强；概念图中的软阴影、反射与光照需要性能和材质实测，不能承诺逐像素复现。

candidates.name: 海报操作台
candidates.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: ONE high-fidelity landscape desktop web interface candidate, around 1600x1000, no browser or monitor frame.
Input image 1 is the current app only for visual family. Input image 2 is an Italian-poster style/material reference, not an edit target. Create a truly different interaction composition, not a recolored three-column dashboard.
Primary request: candidate C, a playful POSTER COLLAGE OPERATING TABLE during Moka brewing, achievable as a 2.5D HTML interactive scene with Blender pre-rendered cutouts. A bold clean Italian advertising poster becomes a hands-on graphic stage. Less room realism than candidate B, more game-like objects and visual composition than candidate A.
Art direction: warm ivory ground, large terracotta diagonal trapezoid and a small very deep blue ink accent, giant condensed slanted 'MOKA' lettering partly behind the object. Tight vintage Italian typography with clean contemporary Chinese labels, fine cream cut-paper outlines, tiny tasteful printed grain, no distressed grunge, 1980s Chinese nostalgia, plastic skeuomorphic widgets or messy sticker pile.
Layout: shallow oblique viewpoint of an ivory counter wedge across the middle; one beautifully modeled upright octagonal silver Moka on a small navy enamel burner is the main pre-rendered cutout at center. The whole pot is visually upright on its own base and all parts align; closed lid, matte black handle and brass valve, simple fine satin aluminum texture, crisp bevels and soft shared shadows. A detached plain cup sits at right foreground. They are isolated sprite-like product renders integrated into the poster stage, not an elaborate room. Use a narrow vertical receipt-shaped order slip tucked at upper right, and a small clipped circular observation lens beside the pot showing a stylized water-path cutaway. This inset can be opened or closed in the same operating context.
Interaction design differs from A/B: controls are three simple paper labels near the burner, obviously HTML buttons, not physical stove details users must manipulate. A small observation/status callout connects the lens and pot, local knowledge appears as one short annotation. A compact dark action pill '关火收杯' is anchored beside the scene, not a large full-width footer. Tiny readiness indicators may accompany actual state, no levels, star scores, tutorials, timers or tutorial entrance.
Chinese text verbatim and sparse: '返回小馆', '慢一点。', '这一杯，由你掌握。', '自由创作', '微火', '小火', '关火收杯', '出液 36 g', '为什么向上？', '展开结构 ↗', '金属很烫，握手柄。'. 'MOKA' display lettering is permitted. Do not add scientific-looking numerical pressure gauges or flavor scores.
Observation lens: simple correct SVG virtual section; water below with air above, funnel straw into water, coffee bed at neck, central chimney up to upper collector. It shows liquid water path turning brown after coffee layer; no pump, no force arrows that suggest coffee powder sucks water. Pot stays assembled on fire. Component view would pause the virtual brew rather than asking users to dismantle a hot pot.
Feasibility: this is intentionally an image-based 2.5D scene, using three or four pre-rendered product states, CSS transforms, SVG liquid/steam path loops, and independent HTML buttons. No full orbital 3D rotation, continuously refracting glass, simulated pours or ray-traced moving lights. Make those modest constraints look intentional: limited perspective, clean overlap, a consistent soft shadow and generous breathing space. Render one elegant actual-looking operating screen, not a printed static poster with no usable controls.
candidates.correction_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit, UI and scientific microcopy correction. Reference image is the edit target. Preserve its exact collage composition, large MOKA lettering, warm cream and rust palette, straight assembled silver pot, paper controls, spacing, all titles, order slip and heat warnings. Make only these corrections: 1) Remove the steam plume coming from the lid knob; the closed pot's knob is not a steam outlet. 2) Replace the paragraph immediately below '为什么向上？' with exactly '下壶内气体受热，压力增大，推动液态水穿过粉层。' Use three short neatly spaced lines of clear contemporary Chinese sans serif. Keep the heading and '展开结构 ↗' link. 3) In the small circular observation inset only, make the narrow funnel tube/path BLUE from the lower water up to the underside of the powder bed; make it COFFEE BROWN only above the bed, through the central chimney and into the upper collector. Keep lower blue water with air space above and correct narrow submerged funnel tube. 4) Replace the already milk-filled transparent foreground cup with a simple EMPTY white ceramic coffee cup in the same position and approximate silhouette, with a restrained small rust inscription if present. It is waiting for coffee while the pot brews. No new widgets, people, clutter or text. Keep the target's width and height and all elements outside these four edits unchanged.

implementation.difficulty: 中，固定镜头下成本较可控
implementation.approach: Blender 预渲染器具透明素材及预制移壶/倒杯短动画，HTML 纸片按钮、CSS 排版与 SVG 出液/火焰/水位反馈。
implementation.tradeoff: 海报风格和材质最容易稳定复现；仅采用预设视角。爆炸视图需要独立部件素材，不能用整张概念图充当可交互页面。
